quests.title: Stolen, by the Rightful Owner

dialogue.t: *sigh* This doesn't make sense. How weird.
It should be around here... But why can't I find it?
My ring... It's gone. It means a lot to me. I must find it...
It's made of brass and is inlaid with a beautiful red gem...
I found it by a lava lake where the shadow dragon Durin fell in the legends. Or at least, this should explain why its luster resembles dark flames...
Whoa...
It is said that the Lord of the Abyss will fix its malefic gaze upon the ring bearer and send an army of darkness to hunt them down.
Oh!

dialogue.sit: Dragonspine doesn't have a lava lake.

dialogue.t: Ahem... My bad. As a poet, I have a propensity for dramatic language and novel tales.
Hehe, truth be told, I found the ring in a Weasel Thieves' nest... It was well-preserved and eye-pleasing, so I kept it.
Hmph, so you're a thief too, you just stole from thieves!
Don't say that... I chanced upon it! That's right, it was chance! And though chance it be, the ring is quite precious to me all the same.

dialogue.sit: Do you have any clue concerning the ring's whereabouts?

dialogue.t: Yeah... I've heard that Weasel Thieves are often spotted around here. They might've stolen my ring while I was sleeping.
Huh, so there really are people who take their rings off before going to bed...

dialogue.sit: I'd never heard of such people before, either.

dialogue.t: Anyway, Paimon doesn't have that habit! You need to think about where to put the ring once you take it off, or you'll be wasting good beauty sleep.

dialogue.sit: Do they even make rings tiny enough for you, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Hmph, of course they do! There's much you still don't know!
Enough. Please refrain from judging other people's way of living before proceeding to ramble on about your own! It's very rude!
...Anyway, if you want to help out... Please keep an eye out for Weasel Thief nests.
I've heard that there is a camp of suspicious Treasure Hoarders around here on the map... I've marked the location out for you.
It's said that Weasel Thieves are often spotted around here. Those sneaky Treasure Hoarders probably have something to do with them... Anyway, please take a look there.
Hmph... A ring stolen from the Weasel Thieves, which was then stolen again by other Weasel Thieves. Paimon'd say it has gone back to its rightful owner!
Oh, come on, just stop it already!
Hey there, has something happened recently?
Oh, you mean the ones in The Chasm... I was assigned to take care of them, but I messed up, so there's really nothing much to say.
Eh... It's impossible for me to capture them again. They are, after all, masters of hide-and-seek. It's so hard to track them down.
But I can help you a bit if these annoying creatures happen to have stolen things from people.
Weasel Thieves trained by Treasure Hoarders are fed at fixed hours in a day. There are three types of Weasel Thieves...
The Golden Weasel Thief is the most cunning one... Then, there's the more common Hoarder Weasel Thief. The dumbest of all is the Amateur Weasel Thief. Well, as for when they show up...

*sigh* There should be a training manual somewhere with the feeding timetable on it, as no one really bothered to remember the exact time. The manual should be in the camp frequented by Weasel Thieves.
Ah... I almost forgot this! Give a whistle if you want to summon them.
Yep, just any old whistle will do. It's not some complicated trick. The key is the timing.
You're back. Did you find it?

dialogue.sit: Take a look. Is this your ring?

dialogue.t: Yes, it is! Thank you so much!
Please take these as your reward. It isn't much, but please don't feel offended. I'll compose verses to eulogize your deeds!

quests.description: The bard Taliesin seeks your help. As it turns out, the ring that he stole from the Weasel Thieves has been stolen once again by another bunch of Weasel Thieves…
